messages:
elaine: Quick async check — rack-7 power upgrade + H100 reservation for Dedicated-C. Milestones over the next 2 weeks? Need clear owners for power signoff, firmware validation, and capacity reservation ticket. cc: @tanvi @sam

tanvi: I can own power signoff. planning a smoke test Wed morning, but need PDUs delivered first.

sam: procurement update — vendor (ironcloud) confirmed partial shipment: 40 H100s ship 2026-05-04, remaining 20 ship 2026-05-11. shipping ref: IC-53729. ETA DC1 week of 5/4. updating procurement sheet now.

jonas: ops note — DC1 only has 3 spare PDUs on-hand. rack-7 needs 6 PDUs. options: new PO or borrow from DC2. pinging facilities.

elaine: proposed owner matrix: tanvi=power signoff + smoke, jonas=rack install ops, sam=procurement lead, me=program mgr/rollout gate. agree?

tanvi: ack. prefer firmware test window Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC. if vendor hosts images need checksums in ticket.

jonas: facilities placed PO for 3 extra PDUs, ETA ~3 days. DC2 can lend 2 PDUs for ~5 days if we accept.

elaine: accept borrow + PO. sam — will borrowing affect customs / ETA?

sam: borrowing doesn't touch customs. shipments are unchanged. I'll add the borrow contingency to ticket #D-7123 and update timelines.

infra-ci-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-05-06 09:00-12:00 UTC for rack-7 smoke tests — /reserve 2143658700

tanvi: test checklist (short):
```
- rpower test
- PDU load balancing
- BMC firmware check
- nvlink sanity
- basic p99 latency run
```

elaine: dependencies: network VLANs (net-eng) and rack PDUs (facilities). @mike-net can you own VLANs? need rack serials for the change.

mike-net: I can do VLANs. scheduling 2h change window Fri 10:00-12:00 UTC. need rack serials and final IP plan.

jonas: rack serials added to ticket #D-7123: RACK-7A, RACK-7B.

elaine: can someone update the Dedicated capacity reservation to reflect partial arrivals? need reservation commit dates adjusted to May 4 (40 units) and May 11 (20 units).

sam: I'll update the reservation ticket and note partial capacity availability. marking 40 units available 2026-05-04, 20 units 2026-05-11.

tanvi: code-review ping: infra/ansible#458 — added PDU mapping and smoke test playbook. small changes, need one approval.

jonas: I'll review this afternoon.

mike-net: note — VLAN changes require NMS update. I'll post the change doc to the ticket.

elaine: thanks — quick recap of actions:
- tanvi: power signoff + run smoke tests
- jonas: rack install + PDU ops + add serials to ticket
- sam: procurement updates, reservation edits, add borrowing contingency
- mike-net: VLAN + NMS change window
- elaine: rollout gate + stakeholder comms

sam: procurement sheet updated: https://sheets.redwood/procurement/IC-53729 — added shipment docs and partial delivery notes.

jonas: facility PO #F-9921 placed for 3 PDUs.

tanvi: PR merged (infra/ansible#458) 15:34 UTC — :tada:

elaine: marking thread resolved for now. will update in Thu standup and all-hands with milestones. :white_check_mark:
